verdict.rationale: JumpCloud's Directory Insights aggregates and standardizes event logs across user activity, and directory events data can be managed and exported through RESTful commands. That gives pull-based access to identity events that downstream systems could poll, but nothing in the evidence shows push-style webhooks or event hooks firing in real time. Missing for 10: documented webhook/event-hook subscriptions, real-time push delivery on user lifecycle and auth events, event payload/filtering docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
